invariants.rationale: Returned value is produced by a stream collect, which always produces a non-null List.
If partitionPath is null, calling getLatestFileSlices likely returns an empty stream, resulting in an empty List.
File IDs produced by fg.getFileId() should not be null in a consistent table state.
The stream applies .distinct() before collecting, so all elements are unique.
File IDs are typically non-empty strings.
